text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 192, March 08, 1939 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 31, DATED MAY 18, 1936, SO AS TO DELETE PARAGRAPH
In order to give opportunity to young graduates of the medical profession to apply for commission in the
Medical Corps Reserve of the Philippine Army, the present requirement that physicians procured for the said
Medical Corps Reserve should have at least one year of practice after the issuance of their corresponding
certificates of registration by the Board of Medical Examiners is hereby eliminated.
For this purpose, Executive Order Numbered Thirty-one, entitled “Procurement of Medical Reserve Officers”
issued on May eighteenth, nineteen hundred thirty-six, is hereby amended by deleting paragraph five-d (3)
Done at the City of Manila, this eighth day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-nine, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the fourth.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
